plugin.note: Scorpions have negligible Defence (-53 melee bonuses) and very low Hitpoints, so any melee weapon clears them instantly; a Dragon scimitar or cheaper is plenty. They carry a small fire spell weakness (25%, King scorpion 20%) if training Magic. Krystilia's task must be done in the Wilderness with risk-appropriate gear.

requirements: No Slayer level is required to receive a Scorpions task.
Krystilia's scorpions must be killed in the Wilderness.
mechanics: Scorpions attack with stab melee at a 4-tick speed and pose almost no threat at low levels.
Their -53 melee defensive bonuses make them fall to any melee weapon.
King scorpions (level 32) also count and have 30 Hitpoints.

methods.label: Melee
methods.summary: Kill any counting scorpion with any melee weapon; they die in one or two hits.
requiredOrKeyItems: Any melee weapon (Dragon scimitar or cheaper)
steps: For starter masters, go to the Al Kharid mine or Dwarven Mine scorpions.
For Krystilia, kill Wilderness scorpions with risk-appropriate gear.
Attack with any melee weapon until the task completes.

methods.label: Wilderness (Krystilia) safe kit
methods.summary: Complete the Krystilia task in the low-level Wilderness with cheap, risk-appropriate gear to minimise PKer loss.
requiredOrKeyItems: Cheap melee weapon and armour you can afford to lose
steps: Bank valuables; wear only risk-appropriate gear before entering the Wilderness.
Kill Wilderness scorpions; they die in one or two hits.
Watch the minimap for PKers and teleport out when threatened.

body:
# Scorpions

Scorpions are a trivial low-level Slayer task assigned by Krystilia, Turael, Spria, and Mazchna. With -53 melee defensive bonuses and very low Hitpoints, any melee weapon clears them instantly; a small fire spell weakness (25%, King scorpion 20%) helps Magic trainers. Starter-master tasks are fastest at the Al Kharid mine or Dwarven Mine; Krystilia's task must be done in the low-level Wilderness with risk-appropriate gear.
